ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a dominant low-intensity (black) background interspersed with a high density of high-intensity (white) circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dense distribution of white circular rings and blobs across the entirety of both the left and right lobes against a solid black pigmentation background.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; approximate 45-60 degree internal angle visible between lobe junctions.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary along the superior edges of both lobes, featuring small-amplitude, high-frequency vertical variations (nicks and peaks).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering into sharp, elevated distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive spatial mapping of white, ring-like pixel clusters (rosettes) varying in diameter, covering approximately 40-50% of the visible surface area.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme density of white circular scarring consistent with historical barnacle colonization patterns covering the majority of the fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Solid white high-intensity patch at the extreme distal tip of the right lobe (viewer right).
